h1: Schema markup so search engines read your data
overview: Schema markup is hidden code that tells search engines what a page contains: the product name, price, availability, brand and review rating. We add it to your store, check it with Google's testing tools and fix any warnings. Review data is only marked up when the reviews are real and shown on the page, as search engines require. You get a short record of what was added to which page type.

faq: Will schema give me star ratings in search?
It makes you eligible, but search engines decide what to show. We cannot promise rich results. We make sure the data is correct, so you are eligible when they choose to show them.
Can you mark up reviews I do not have?
No. Search engines require reviews to be real and visible on the page. We only add review data from genuine reviews, and we do not fabricate ratings.
Will it work with my theme?
Most themes include basic schema already. We check what is there first, remove duplicates and fill in the gaps, so there is no conflict.
Do I need a developer afterward?
No. The schema is added to your templates, so new products get it automatically. We give you notes on how to check it in future.
